spec.description: Nokia SR Linux streaming telemetry lab: gNMI telemetry collected by gnmic into Prometheus, syslog collected by Alloy into Loki.

spec.title: Fabric throughput
spec.description: Traffic rate of the cabled ports of all switches. Vertical markers show SR Linux events from the logs: orange a port going up or down, red a BGP session changing state, blue a configuration commit. Hover a marker for the message.

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description: Traffic rate of the cabled ports, as measured by SR Linux. Vertical markers show SR Linux events from the logs: orange a port going up or down, red a BGP session changing state, blue a configuration commit. Hover a marker for the message.

spec.title: BGP
spec.description: BGP statistics of the default network instance.

spec.title: Routes and MACs
spec.description: Active routes of the default network instance, of which ECMP routes, and MAC addresses across all MAC-VRFs.

spec.title: Ports
spec.description: Oper-state of the cabled ports.

spec.title: Last commit
spec.description: Time of the last configuration commit. Change the configuration over gNMI or the CLI and watch it update.

spec.title: Fabric topology
spec.description: Live view of the fabric. Each half of a link is coloured by the traffic rate leaving that end, the port bubbles by oper-state. Generated with the Grafana bundle export of containerlab.

spec.title: Log volume
spec.description: Syslog messages per severity.

spec.title: Logs
spec.description: Syslog messages of the selected switches and applications.

spec.title: BGP sessions
spec.description: BGP sessions of the fabric: the eBGP underlay to the spines and the iBGP EVPN overlay between the loopbacks. Routes count every address family.

spec.title: BGP sessions
spec.description: BGP sessions across the fabric, underlay and overlay.

spec.title: Fabric ports
spec.description: Oper-state of the cabled ports of all switches.

spec.expr: count(interface_oper_state == 1 and on(source, interface_name) srl:interface:in_use) or vector(0)

spec.title: Client traffic
spec.description: Traffic the clients send into the fabric. Start it with traffic.sh.

spec.title: EVPN MAC addresses
spec.description: MAC addresses in the MAC-VRFs of the leaves: learnt on a local port, or received in EVPN routes.

spec.title: Warnings
spec.description: SR Linux events of severity warning or worse in the selected time range, such as a port or BGP session going down. Debug traces are not counted. See the Logs tab.

spec.title: Alerts
spec.description: Alerts of the lab and how many switches or ports they fire for: BGPSessionDown, PortDown, PortErrors and HighCPU. The rules are in configs/prometheus/rules.yml; Alerting > Alert rules lists them with their state.

spec.title: Traffic rate
spec.description: Traffic rate of the selected ports. Vertical markers show SR Linux events from the logs: orange a port going up or down, red a BGP session changing state, blue a configuration commit. Hover a marker for the message.

spec.title: Packets
spec.description: Packets per second of the selected ports.

spec.title: Errors and discards
spec.description: Error and discarded packets per second of the selected ports. A few discards now and then are normal; a steady rate is not.

spec.title: Ports
spec.description: Cabled ports of the selected switches. Error and discard counters count since boot.

spec.expr: max by (source, interface_name, description) (interface_oper_state{source=~"$Node", interface_name=~"$Interface"} * on(source, interface_name) group_left(description) srl:interface:in_use)

spec.description: Pick the switches to show. A red outline marks a switch with a BGP session or a cabled port down.

spec.title: Switches and ports
spec.description: Pick switches and ports. A red dot marks a switch with a BGP session or a cabled port down.

spec.expr: max by (Node, Interface) (label_replace(label_replace(interface_oper_state and on(source, interface_name) srl:interface:in_use, "Node", "$1", "source", "(.+)"), "Interface", "$1", "interface_name", "(.+)"))

spec.title: Applications
spec.description: Pick SR Linux applications. An orange or red dot marks an application that logged warnings or errors.

spec.expr: sum by (Application) (count_over_time({job="syslog", source=~"$Node", kind=~"$Kind"} | label_format Application="{{.application}}" [$__range]))
sum by (app) (count_over_time({job="syslog", source=~"$Node", kind=~"$Kind", level=~"warning|err|error|crit|alert|emerg"} | label_format app="{{.application}}" [$__range]))

spec.description: Pick the switches whose logs to show.
Pick the switches to show. Only the leaves run EVPN.
Show SR Linux events only, or the debug traces of its applications too.

spec.title: MAC table
spec.description: MAC addresses in the MAC-VRFs of the selected leaves. A learnt MAC sits behind a local port, an EVPN MAC behind the VTEP of another leaf, which advertised it in an EVPN type 2 route.

spec.expr: max by (source, network_instance_name, mac_address, mac_type, points_to) (label_replace(label_replace(network_instance_bridge_table_mac_table_mac_type{source=~"$Node"}, "points_to", "leaf$1", "destination", "(?:vtep )?10\\.0\\.1\\.(\\d+)"), "points_to", "local port e$1-$2", "destination", "ethernet-(\\d+)/(\\d+)\\..*"))

spec.title: EVPN routes
spec.description: EVPN routes per switch. Type 2 (MAC/IP) routes advertise MAC addresses, type 3 (inclusive multicast) routes the VTEPs that take part in a MAC-VRF. The spines reflect the routes of each leaf to the others without using them; the leaves receive every route from both spines and use one copy.

spec.title: MAC addresses
spec.description: MAC addresses per leaf: learnt on a local port or received over EVPN.

spec.title: VXLAN traffic per remote VTEP
spec.description: Vertical markers show SR Linux events from the logs: orange a port going up or down, red a BGP session changing state, blue a configuration commit. Hover a marker for the message. Traffic each leaf exchanges with the other leaves over VXLAN, counted per remote VTEP. Needs tunnel vxlan-tunnel statistics enabled, as in the startup configuration of the leaves.
